A pyramid diagram illustrating the hierarchical structure of the civil service. The pyramid is divided into five horizontal layers. Top layer: "Administrative Class (Permanent Secretaries, Directors)". Second layer down: "Professional/Technical Class (Doctors, Engineers, Lawyers)". Third layer: "Executive Class (Executive Officers)". Fourth layer: "Clerical Class (Clerks, Typists)". Bottom widest layer: "Auxiliary/Manipulative Class (Cleaners, Messengers)". A vertical arrow points upwards on the left side; an arrow points downwards on the right side. Clean flat textbook illustration, white background.
